Account background: enterprise contact center provider with ~4k agents across NA/EU; existing stack: proprietary CTI + Salesforce + in-house KB. Primary driver: reduce AHT and improve NPS for live voice/chat. Wants real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions) + tight guardrails to avoid hallucinations. Key asks: p50 suggestion generation <100ms, p95 <250ms during steady state; graceful degradation under 3x peak (cached templates + lightweight model); tool-calling for one-click action (create/update SF case, trigger IVR transfer).

POC scope: 1) integrate Redwood hosted/dedicated endpoint with their CTI adapter; 2) streaming suggestion hook in agent UI; 3) ticket summarization pipeline for post-call notes; 4) rule-based guardrails + evals on 5000 prompt pairs.
